books.notes: Template entry - please fill in with actual Instagram posts

how_to_update: 1. When you post a new book on Instagram, add it to this file
2. Include the post date and any caption text
3. Try to match the ISBN with books in books.csv for consistency
4. The post_url should be the Instagram post permalink

fields.title: Book title as shown in the post
fields.author: Author/photographer name
fields.isbn: ISBN if available (to match with main collection)
fields.caption: The Instagram caption text
fields.notes: Any additional notes about the post or book
